title: Where the held error comes from, and the leukemia study at full depth
set_out: Read the division route and the leukemia study's first full-depth samples; keep every machine working.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: The division route, IMR90 dividing and resting (PHY-006, DEV-ERASE-01)
entries.what: Nine IMR90 samples (proliferating, senescent, dividing past senescence with SV40) counted by the one command at 10 million read pairs.
entries.outcome: Dividing adds about a twentieth of the held error; the cells still dividing with SV40 read the senescent level. Replication error is not the firm rate's missing half; upkeep itself is.

open_at_turnover: Running on GitHub's machines: the leukemia study's Reh control and its UHRF1 knockout at full depth, each split across 20 machines, then merged and read by the one command.
